caption_layout.method: Each exact cue rendered separately at time zero with the same libass style on black; white-glyph bounds and row bands; visual sheets checked separately

review.sampled_visual: Inspected 12 final review images (six frames each: opening, ending, all 10 cuts) plus one midpoint frame for each of 21 cues, displayed in six contact sheets. Samples overlap. Source scenes and first-pass sheets were also inspected.
findings: Original time-jump title fully readable after custom FFmpeg layout fallback.
No caption glyph exceeds two row bands; all 21 glyph bounds end above y=1440 on the 1920px frame.
Bridge speaker face remains near the right edge just after the cut around output 6.17s; some head/edge clipping remains in those samples. Face tracking cannot be marked fully accepted.
Shot-level crop excludes the other actor and parts of the gesturing robot hand; the wide interaction is not fully retained.
Caption-speed and short-duration warnings remain; cues 13 and 17 last 0.38s and 0.36s.
No full-motion playback or listening was performed; chopped-word, naturalness, overlapping-word timing and perceptual sync acceptance remain open.

criteria.evidence: Final metadata and QC measurements; title uses blurred fill, not simple cover crop.

criteria.criterion: Speaker stays in frame in sampled frames
criteria.evidence: Manual crops improve samples but moving bridge speaker still approaches/clips right edge around 6.17s.
All 21 cue midpoint frames inspected and each cue independently rendered with identical libass style; max two text bands, bounds <=1440px.
Official-subtitle wording corrections and provisional overlapping timings listed; listening not performed.
